title.en: System updates use site release announcements
title.zh: 系统更新改用本站上线公告

summary.en: The administrator update checker uses announcements of successfully deployed site releases and distinguishes cached results and incomparable builds.
summary.zh: 管理员更新检查读取本站成功上线公告，区分缓存结果及无法比较先后的构建。

body.en:
## Site release announcements

The administrator update checker reads the latest successfully deployed OmniMux site announcement. A successful deployment and its health checks publish the version and publication time automatically. The announcement is independent of the running application; it is neither an upstream upgrade inventory nor an automatic upgrade. Release details open the existing API Updates page in the current language.

Announcement failures remain errors. Previous results are marked as cached, and results from the retired source are not reused for the new source. Different site build identifiers with the same upstream version do not establish a newer or older release. This change does not activate models or alter pricing or sign-in.
body.zh:
## 本站上线版本公告

管理员更新检查改读 OmniMux 本站最近成功上线的公告。部署及健康检查成功后，系统自动发布版本和发布时间。公告独立于当前运行的应用，不是上游可升级清单，也不会自动升级；查看详情会打开当前语言现有的 API 更新页。

公告读取失败仍会报错，上次结果明确标为缓存，旧来源结果不再用于新来源。上游版本相同但本站构建标识不同，不能据此声称较新或较旧。本次不启用模型、不改变价格或登录方式。

title.en: OmniMux CLI 0.5.0: character and reference-video creation
title.zh: OmniMux 命令行0.5.0：角色创建与参考视频生成

summary.en: Create and reuse character sheets, optionally generate multiview sheets, submit reference-driven videos, recover original requests and download completed files through the account-scoped CLI.
summary.zh: 通过账号命令行创建和复用角色、可选生成多角度设定图、结合参考视频生成成片，并按原请求恢复、等待和下载成品。

body.en:
Version **0.5.0** adds account-scoped character creation and reuse, optional multiview sheets, reference-video generation, bounded waits, original-request recovery and verified downloads. New device approvals explicitly include creative permissions and account credits/subscription usage; existing credentials are not expanded automatically.

Character and multiview outputs share owned workbench history. A multiview sheet contains several views in one image and has a separate generation charge. Actual image dimensions are determined by the downloaded file. Consumers do not choose models or supplier groups.

Video defaults are motion mode and 480p. The server inspects reference clips of 4–30 seconds; callers do not provide a duration override. Finished duration may differ, and a four-second reference/request has produced about 3.71 seconds. Reference audio is supplied to generation, but output loudness may change; lossless or bit-for-bit audio preservation is not promised. Inspect the completed file rather than treating task success or request metadata as media acceptance.

Creation requires a compatible enabled service. Reuse the original request ID after uncertain submission instead of opening a new billable request. Waiting timeout does not cancel cloud work; downloads refuse overwrite by default.
body.zh:
**0.5.0** 增加账号角色创建与复用、可选多角度设定图、参考视频生成、有期限等待、原请求恢复及完整文件下载。新设备授权会明确说明创作权限及账号积分/订阅额度使用；旧凭据不会自动扩权。

角色和多角度作品与网页本人历史互通。多角度是在同一张图片中的多个视图，会另行消耗生成额度；图片实际像素以下载文件为准。不要求用户选择模型或供应商分组。

视频默认采用运动交换和480档，后台识别4–30秒参考视频，不接受用户手填时长。成片时长可能不同，已观察到4秒参考及请求返回约3.71秒成片。参考原声会传入生成，但成片音量可能变化，不承诺无损或逐个音频采样完全相同。请检查下载成片，不将任务成功或请求参数当作成品验收。

创建需要服务支持并启用相应能力。提交结果不明时按原请求编号查回，不另开收费新单；等待超时不取消云端任务，下载默认拒绝覆盖已有文件。

title.en: GPT Image standard specifications and routing safeguards
title.zh: GPT Image 标准规格与自动选路保护

summary.en: The standard route supports seven image sizes, one medium-quality PNG image, and one reference. Full prompts must satisfy 8192 Unicode code points, 16384 UTF-8 bytes, and 5000 service-counted o200k_base tokens; unsupported requests are explicitly rejected.
summary.zh: 标准路线支持七种尺寸、medium 质量单张 PNG 和单参考；完整提示词须同时满足 8192 个 Unicode 码点、16384 个 UTF-8 字节和本服务 o200k_base 计数 5000 个词元的上限，未支持规格明确拒绝。

body.zh:
标准服务路线按单张报价，仅接受 JSON 请求，质量为 `medium`，输出为 PNG。支持七种画幅及对应精确像素：1:1（1024x1024）、2:3（1024x1536）、3:2（1536x1024）、3:4（1024x1360）、4:3（1360x1024）、9:16（1088x1920）、16:9（1920x1088）。3:4 / 4:3 的旧 1365 像素边调整为 1360；旧显式尺寸明确拒绝，不静默换规格。

文生图可不带参考；编辑最多使用一张公开 HTTPS 的 JPEG、PNG 或 WebP 图片，单张最多 5 MiB、解码后最多 4000 万像素、任一边最多 23170 像素。角色板和多视角板继续保留，多视角为同一张图中的多个视图。

完整提示词须同时满足 **8192 个 Unicode 码点、16384 个 UTF-8 字节，以及本服务使用 `o200k_base` 计算的 5000 个词元**上限。这会拒绝部分包含大量四字节字符或词元较多的原 4000 字符工作台长描述；不截断、不压缩、不替换输入。本服务的词元计数用于请求准入，不代表供应商最终计费量，也不保证单次采购成本上限。独立 Flare / Sunburst 型号的官方 32000 字符事实与既有合同不因本标准路线收窄而改变。

多张输出、多参考、更高质量、其他输出格式及未审核扩展会明确拒绝。已识别标准路线的公开请求在创建供应商任务和预留资金前拒绝；工作台排队任务可能随后明确无费失败。实际普通及会员价格以提交前报价为准，同档位的合格换线不追加客户费用。

只有能够确定首选未创建供应商任务，并符合内置重试规则和总预算时才会尝试已审核备用；不承诺始终有两条健康线路。已接单、超时、断连或缺回执的原任务继续核对，不会自动重复生成，旧失败任务也不会自动重发。
body.en:
The standard service is quoted per image and accepts JSON requests only, with `medium` quality and PNG output. Seven aspect ratios map to exact pixels: 1:1 (1024x1024), 2:3 (1024x1536), 3:2 (1536x1024), 3:4 (1024x1360), 4:3 (1360x1024), 9:16 (1088x1920), and 16:9 (1920x1088). The old 1365-pixel edge for 3:4 / 4:3 changes to 1360. Old explicit sizes are rejected rather than silently replaced.

Text-to-image requests may omit a reference; editing accepts at most one public HTTPS JPEG, PNG, or WebP image, up to 5 MiB, 40 million decoded pixels, and 23170 pixels on either edge. Character sheets and multi-view boards remain available; multiple views are rendered within one image.

The complete prompt must satisfy all three limits: **8192 Unicode code points, 16384 UTF-8 bytes, and 5000 tokens counted by this service with `o200k_base`**. This rejects some existing 4000-character workbench descriptions containing many four-byte characters or a high token count. Inputs are not truncated, compressed, or replaced. The service token count determines request eligibility; it does not represent final supplier billing usage or guarantee a per-request procurement cost ceiling. The vendor's 32000-character fact and existing contracts for the separate Flare / Sunburst models are not changed by this standard-service restriction.

Multiple output images, multiple references, higher quality, other output formats, and unreviewed extensions are explicitly rejected. Identified standard-route public requests are rejected before creating a supplier task or reserving funds; queued workbench tasks may fail explicitly without a charge after validation. Standard and member prices are shown before submission. Switching an eligible route within the same account tier does not add a customer charge.

A reviewed backup may be attempted only when no supplier task was created on the preferred route and native retry rules and the total attempt budget allow it. Two healthy routes are not guaranteed at all times. Accepted tasks and tasks with timeouts, disconnections, or missing acknowledgements are reconciled against the original request without automatic duplicate generation. Old failed tasks are not automatically resubmitted.

title.en: Object-swap instructions determine targets and scope from references
title.zh: 对象交换按参考内容确定目标与范围

summary.en: The revised object-swap instructions ask the generation model to map all reference images to the original video, use the references for complete target appearance and retain the original dynamic structure and non-target content. Existing framing, duration and billing rules remain in force.
summary.zh: 修订后的对象交换指令由生成模型结合全部参考图片与原视频自主对应，以图片定义目标完整外观，保留原片动态结构与非目标内容；沿用既有画幅、时长与计费规则。

body.en:
The default object-swap instructions ask the video-generation model to interpret the original video and all reference images, using their semantic, functional and interaction relationships to determine reasonable replacement targets and scope. Image order identifies references; it does not predetermine each image's role. You can submit without a personal prompt. This flow adds neither a separate recognition model nor a target-selection step.

Reference images define each replacement target's complete appearance and recognizable features; the original video defines the event progression, action timing, spatial relationships and shot organization. The instructions ask for complete replacement according to those mappings, removing original features that conflict with the reference target without importing unrelated image content.

The instructions ask to change only what is necessary for the replacement and retain the remaining visuals and original sound. While preserving the target definition, they allow adjustments to perspective, occlusion, contact, lighting and motion response needed for natural integration, maintaining the original interaction logic and continuity throughout the video. Multiple images may complement one target or correspond to different targets, with stable mappings throughout; they should not add duplicates, blend conflicting appearances or force in content without a reasonable match. These are generation goals, not a guarantee of exact preservation or a correct interpretation on every request.

An explicitly supplied, valid personal supplement takes priority; in the workbench, the personal-prompt switch controls whether that draft is sent. A saved character's verified identity and species apply only when that image is actually used for identity replacement; when used for a partial replacement, it applies only to the corresponding part.

The current 10 built-in object-swap sidebar presets keep their descriptions, previews and reference videos, but their generic display sentence is no longer sent as a generation supplement. This change does not redefine Explore's apply behavior or community task descriptions.

The default instructions are shared with the existing influencer video-creation integration. This update changes no public request or response fields; existing standard-framing limits, positive whole-second requests and billing rules remain in force. It does not add these instructions to an arbitrary generic video request, or enable adaptive framing or automatic original-duration editing.

This entry describes the revised default instructions. Publishing this documentation does not establish that the production workbench has received the update; availability depends on the deployed site version.
body.zh:
对象交换的默认提示会让视频生成模型结合原视频与全部参考图片，依据参考内容与原片的语义、功能和交互关系，自主确定合理的替换目标与范围。图片顺序只用于指代，不预设各图用途。不填写个人提示词也可提交；流程不增加额外识别模型，也不要求用户点选目标。

参考图片定义替换后目标的完整外观与可辨识特征；原视频定义事件进程、动作时序、空间关系和镜头组织。指令要求按确定的对应关系完整替换，消除与参考目标冲突的原有特征，不引入图片中的无关内容。

指令要求只修改完成替换所必需的部分，其余画面与原音沿用原片。在保持目标定义的前提下，允许自然融合所需的透视、遮挡、接触、光影和运动响应调整，保持原有交互逻辑与全片连续性。多张图片可互补同一目标或分别对应不同目标，对应关系贯穿全片稳定一致；不重复增添或混合冲突形象，缺乏合理对应的内容不强行加入。这些是生成目标，不保证每次都精确保留或正确理解对应关系。

有效且明确传入的个人补充优先；工作台中的个人提示开关决定是否发送该草稿。已保存角色经过核验的身份与物种，仅在该图实际用于身份替换时适用；局部引用只作用于对应部分。

当前 10 项内置对象交换侧栏预设保留原说明、预览与参考视频，但其通用展示句不再作为生成补充发送。本次没有改变探索区的应用行为或社区任务描述。

这些默认规则也用于既有的角色视频创建集成入口。本次不改变公开请求或响应字段，沿用既有标准画幅限制、正整数秒请求与计费规则，不会向任意通用视频请求自动添加这些提示，也不启用自适应画幅或自动沿用原片时长的编辑方式。

本条记录说明修订后的默认指令。文档发布不代表生产工作台已更新，实际可用性以已部署的网站版本为准。

title.en: Own-account usage export and schema compatibility
title.zh: 本人用量导出与结构定义兼容

summary.en: Usage-log export preserves account visibility and requires a terminal success record; model-specific format conversion preserves supported constraints.
summary.zh: 用量日志导出保留账户可见范围，并须以末行成功结果确认完成；格式转换按模型能力保留受支持约束。

body.en:
User-API usage export is separate from model generation APIs. It exports the authenticated user’s own visible logs as newline-delimited JSON, followed by a terminal success/count object. An HTTP 200 or partial records alone do not establish completion. Export availability is operator-controlled, each account has one concurrent export, and the configured time-range limit does not set retention or delete logs.

Gemini schemas that cannot fit its legacy typed schema can use original JSON Schema on compatible v1beta or Vertex AI routes; older routes may lose unsupported constraints. Thinking settings are matched to the exact model, not a universal effort budget. No catalog activation or pricing change is claimed.

Browser chat history and settings are isolated per account. Legacy shared records remain in the original browser without automatic loading, assignment or deletion; signing out clears the visible conversation and unsent draft. Server tasks, artifacts and billing records are not cleanup targets.
body.zh:
用户接口的用量导出与模型生成接口分开，按逐行 JSON 导出已认证用户本人可见的日志，并以包含成功状态和数量的末行结束。仅收到 200 或部分记录不能认定完成。导出是否开放由管理员控制，每账户仅一个并发导出；时间跨度限制不设置保留期，也不删除日志。

无法装入 Gemini 旧式结构定义的约束，可在兼容的 v1beta 或 Vertex AI 线路使用原始 JSON Schema；旧式线路可能丢失不支持的约束。思考设置按具体模型匹配，不代表统一计算预算。本次不宣称模型启用或价格变化。

浏览器聊天记录及设置按账户隔离。旧共享记录保留在原浏览器，不自动加载、分配或删除；退出时清空可见聊天和未发送草稿。服务器任务、作品和账单不是清理对象。

title.en: Video plugin duration and upload compatibility
title.zh: 视频插件时长与上传兼容

summary.en: Automatic duration remains opt-in per installed plugin and model contract; character-workbench media limits remain in force.
summary.zh: 自动时长仍以已安装插件及模型说明允许为前提，角色工作台媒体限制继续有效。

body.en:
Automatic duration (`-1`) is accepted only by an installed plugin that declares the capability and a model contract that permits it. Reservation uses the supported maximum and completion settles reported usage. Positive durations retain their model-specific limits.

Plugin multipart uploads use the body boundary generated for the forwarded request. This does not change the character workbench’s reference rules (2–30-second motion-transfer input, 4–30-second object-swap input and 4–30-whole-second output), media checks, or upload limits, and does not launch or enable a video model.
body.zh:
只有已安装插件声明能力且模型说明允许时，自动时长（`-1`）才会被接受。预扣使用支持的最长时长，完成后结算报告的实际用量；正数时长仍遵循模型各自限制。

插件表单上传采用转发请求实际生成的内容边界。本次不改变角色工作台参考规则（动作迁移输入 2 至 30 秒、对象替换输入 4 至 30 秒、成片 4 至 30 整数秒）、媒体检查或上传上限，也不代表新视频模型启用或上架。

title.en: Plugin request compatibility and converted-stream billing
title.zh: 插件请求兼容与转换流结算

summary.en: Plugin hosts support ordered requests; converted text streams settle delivered output under their documented failure rules.
summary.zh: 插件宿主支持保留请求顺序；转换文本流按已交付内容及规定的失败规则结算。

body.en:
The gateway can load plugins that require ordered request members when the installed plugin and host versions are compatible. This does not activate or launch TypeSafe models.

Cross-protocol requests map media by MIME type. Converted Chat Completions and Responses streams can settle delivered output after interruption; an upstream failure before any output reaches the client is not charged by this specific rule. Hosted-search charges follow reported usage and the applicable tool price. No model prices or catalog entries are changed by this documentation update.
body.zh:
宿主与插件版本匹配时，网关可加载要求保留请求成员顺序的插件。这不代表 TypeSafe 模型已启用或上架。

跨格式请求按媒体实际类型映射内容。Chat Completions 与 Responses 之间转换的流在中断后仍可结算已交付内容；按该特定规则，上游在内容送达客户端之前失败不收费。托管搜索按报告用量和适用工具价格结算。本次文档不更改模型价格或模型目录。

title.en: Reference-video input requirements separated from output framing
title.zh: 参考视频按输入要求接收，具体问题统一顶部提示

summary.en: The character workbench accepts compliant reference ratios independently of output settings. Standard-framing object swap remains available; an unsupported preservation request is explained only in a top notification on submission.
summary.zh: 角色工作台按输入要求接收合法参考比例；保留现有标准画幅对象替换，无法保留原画幅时只在实际提交后通过顶部气泡说明。

body.en:
The character workbench checks a reference video's actual input properties independently of ordinary output framing. A 5:4, 1:1, 4:3, 21:9 or other ratio within **0.4–2.5** is not rejected at selection merely because it is absent from the output menu; the clip must also meet the format, dimensions, pixel count, frame-rate and duration requirements.

- Reference files support MP4/MOV with H.264/H.265, up to **200 MiB (209,715,200 bytes)**. Ordinary files and decoded Base64 uploads keep their **100 MiB** ceiling. Large video uploads must pass actual MP4/MOV container checks; a filename alone does not establish validity.
- Motion transfer accepts **2–30-second reference input** while the output duration remains an independent **4–30 whole seconds** setting. Object swap accepts **4–30-second input** and retains the existing standard-framing workflow: 480p allows source framing matching 16:9, 9:16 or 3:4; 720p allows 16:9 or 9:16. Its actual source duration is rounded to whole seconds for the request, with existing request-duration billing. **Automatic original-video editing is not enabled.**
- A valid 5:4 reference can be selected without an inline framing warning. If object swap cannot preserve its framing, only actual submission produces a **top notification** explaining the current service limitation. This stops before task distribution or generation billing, keeps the reference, and lets you choose motion transfer. No silent cropping, stretching, trimming or mode switching occurs.
- Browser metadata or playback failure alone does not mark a supported reference invalid. A session-only server preflight checks without model generation or generation billing; generation validates the media again.
- The Desert Duo preset uses its corresponding full-resolution reference instead of its small card preview. Failed candidate checks keep the last valid selection. Specific upload, media or service problems use the **top notification**, and temporary failures can be retried.

These changes concern the website workbench and file-upload limits. The internal `/pg/influencer/motion/inspect` preflight is not a public gateway-token or `/v1` API; this release does not announce new public video-generation parameters. A successful media check is not a completed generation or a guarantee of every editing capability. Existing generation billing rules remain in force.
body.zh:
角色工作台按参考视频真实的输入属性检查，与普通成片画幅分别处理。5:4、1:1、4:3、21:9 或其他位于 **0.4 至 2.5** 内的比例，不会仅因未出现在成片选项中而在选择时被拒绝；素材还须同时满足格式、边长、总像素、帧率与时长要求。

- MP4/MOV、H.264/H.265 参考视频最大 **200 MiB（209,715,200 字节）**；普通文件与 Base64 解码后文件仍为 **100 MiB**。大视频须通过真实 MP4/MOV 容器检查，文件名本身不代表合规。
- 动作迁移接收 **2 至 30 秒参考输入**，独立设置的成片时长仍为 **4 至 30 整数秒**。对象替换接收 **4 至 30 秒输入**，保留现有标准画幅方式：480P 原片须匹配 16:9、9:16、3:4；720P 须匹配 16:9、9:16。原片真实时长四舍五入为整数秒请求，沿用按请求时长计费的规则。**本次不启用自动原片编辑。**
- 合法 5:4 参考视频可以选入，不在素材区显示画幅红字。对象替换无法保留该画幅时，只在实际提交后通过**顶部气泡消息**说明当前服务限制；该拒绝发生在任务分发与生成扣费之前，保留素材，用户可选择动作迁移。不静默裁切、拉伸、截短或切换模式。
- 浏览器无法读取元数据或播放，不会单独作为素材不合法的依据。登录会话使用的服务器预检不调用生成模型、不扣生成积分，正式生成仍会再次校验。
- Desert Duo 预设改用对应高清参考片，卡片保留轻量预览。候选素材检查失败时，保留最后一次有效选择；具体上传、媒体或服务问题统一使用**顶部气泡消息**，临时失败可重试。

本次调整涉及网站工作台与文件上传额度。内部 `/pg/influencer/motion/inspect` 预检不是公开网关令牌或 `/v1` 接口，本次不宣告新增公开视频生成参数。媒体检查通过不代表成片已经完成，也不代表任意编辑目标均可执行；既有生成计费规则仍然适用。

title.en: Reference-video timing compatibility
title.zh: 参考视频时间记录兼容性

summary.en: Reference-video preparation now supports narrowly bounded AAC timing rounding and calculates the playable audio tail once, with full decoding, safety isolation and existing limits retained.
summary.zh: 参考视频准备已支持 AAC 时间记录的有限舍入兼容，并按音频末尾的可播放范围只计算一次；完整解码、安全隔离和既有限制保持不变。

body.en:
This compatibility adjustment for reference-video preparation is live in the character workbench. The original reference that triggered a timing rejection now passes preparation and is accepted into the generation queue; this does not assert that generation has completed.

AAC container timing may differ from decoded audio by at most one sample per block, provided the timeline remains continuous and cumulative drift never exceeds one sample. Larger discrepancies, gaps and overlaps remain invalid. The container's tail length and encoder padding bound the same audio block: use their intersection once, not two successive reductions. Real content is not trimmed to make a reference eligible.

Full decoding of the actual video and audio in a safety-isolated environment remains required. The complete reference stays within 4 to 30 seconds, inclusive, and the intake ceiling remains 100 MiB (104857600 bytes). This does not establish universal supplier compatibility. Public API paths and request/response shapes, model routing and pricing are unchanged.
body.zh:
角色工作台参考视频准备的兼容性调整已上线。此前因时间记录被拒绝的原始参考素材现已通过准备检查并进入生成队列；这不代表成片生成已经完成。

AAC 容器时间记录与解码音频每段最多允许一个采样点的差异，前提是时间线连续，累计漂移始终不超过一个采样点。更大的偏差、空隙或重叠仍会拒绝。末尾长度与编码补齐部分约束同一段音频，按两者交集只计算一次，不连续扣除两次，也不裁去真实内容来让素材符合要求。

实际视频及音轨仍须在安全隔离环境中完整解码；完整参考素材仍限定为 4 至 30 秒，包含两个端点，接收上限仍为 100 MiB（104857600 字节）。本次不承诺所有供应商均兼容。公开接口路径、请求与响应格式、模型路由及价格均不变。

title.en: R2 browser direct uploads and downloads are live
title.zh: R2 浏览器直传直下已上线

summary.en: Browser uploads and stored task previews/downloads now transfer directly with R2. Existing authorization, confirmation, retention, and media-preparation checks remain.
summary.zh: 浏览器上传及已存任务预览、下载现可直接与 R2 传输，既有授权、确认、保留期限和媒体准备检查仍保留。

body.en:
R2 browser direct transfers went live on October 12, 2026. Production browser acceptance covered image/video uploads, saved image/video attachments, and video playback and seeking.

- Browser uploads reuse presign → PUT the original File with the returned required signed `upload_headers` and `credentials: "omit"` → confirm. Do not send OmniMux Bearer credentials to R2. Only the documented 501 unsupported-storage response permits multipart fallback. Signed `If-None-Match: *` prevents overwriting an existing object. Upload tickets default to 15 minutes and cannot exceed 1 hour.
- Uploads must be non-empty and no larger than 100 MiB (104857600 bytes). Confirmation compares R2 HEAD size with the original ticket declaration and checks matching type metadata; it does not inspect the full body or prove valid media. Only a pending, owned, unexpired record becomes active. Existing retention, quota, and separate reference-media checks remain.
- A recognized task-content GET can request `delivery=direct`, plus `download=1` for a final R2 attachment response. Existing authorization and an eligible storage hit precede a signed GET valid for 5 minutes via 307. Default canonical model references keep bytes; HEAD, local storage, and unsupported direct delivery keep existing behavior. Initial upstream collection and reference processing still use the server.
- Current public bucket URLs remain readable by their holders. Signed GET does not make public objects private or guarantee immediate revocation. No measured speed improvement is claimed.
body.zh:
R2 浏览器直传直下已于 2026 年 10 月 12 日上线。生产浏览器验收已覆盖图片和视频上传、图片和视频附件保存，以及视频播放与拖动。

- 浏览器上传复用申请凭证 → 携带返回的必需签名 `upload_headers`，以 `credentials: "omit"` PUT 原始 File → 确认。不要向 R2 发送本站 Bearer 凭证。只有明确的 501 存储不支持响应才回退表单上传；签名的 `If-None-Match: *` 防止覆盖已存在对象。上传凭证默认有效 15 分钟，最长不超过 1 小时。
- 文件须大于零且不超过 100 MiB（104857600 字节）。确认用 R2 HEAD 比较实际大小与最初凭证声明，检查类型元数据一致，不完整读取正文，也不证明真实媒体合法。只有属于当前用户、待确认且未过期的记录转为可用；既有保留期限、配额及独立参考媒体检查仍保留。
- 受支持的任务产物 GET 可请求 `delivery=direct`，下载再加 `download=1`，让最终 R2 响应按附件返回。既有授权和符合条件的存储命中在先，再经 307 转向有效期为 5 分钟的签名 GET。提供给模型的默认规范参考地址仍返回字节；HEAD、本地存储和不支持直下时保留既有行为。首次上游回存和参考处理仍经服务器。
- 当前公开桶地址仍可由持有链接的人读取。签名 GET 不会让公开对象变私密，也不保证立即撤销；本条不声称已经测得速度提升。

title.en: Reference video and output framing contracts separated
title.zh: 参考视频与成片画幅契约分离

summary.en: A reference clip no longer has to match a fixed ratio. Motion transfer offers an independent Frame setting; object swap preserves the clip's own framing when the bound line can produce it and says so honestly when it cannot.
summary.zh: 参考视频不再必须匹配固定比例。动作迁移提供独立的成片画幅设置；对象替换在当前线路可产出时保留参考画幅，不能保留时给出准确提示。

body.en:
Input media and output framing were previously coupled: the reference clip had to match one of 16:9, 9:16, or 3:4, and the same value was sent as the output ratio. That produced a misleading "unsupported aspect ratio" error for clips such as 5:4, and let the form offer 3:4 on 720p even though the bound 720p line only evidences 16:9 and 9:16.

The contracts are now separate. The clip's own ratio is input metadata, not an eligibility gate: a non-standard clip can still drive motion transfer, which gains an independent Frame setting bounded to what the bound line can produce. Object swap must preserve the reference framing, so it submits only when the clip's own ratio is standard and producible on the chosen tier — 480p allows 16:9, 9:16, 3:4; 720p allows 16:9, 9:16 — and otherwise stops before generation with an accurate reason. The workbench never crops, stretches, or letterboxes the clip silently.

The workbench now also exposes GET /pg/influencer/motion/options (session-only), so the form offers only the output framings the bound lines evidence, without revealing channel or vendor details. Server-side media inspection, duration bounds, audio extraction and native billing are unchanged.
body.zh:
此前输入素材与输出画幅是绑定的：参考视频必须匹配 16:9、9:16 或 3:4 之一，且同一值直接作为成片比例提交。这让 5:4 等素材收到误导性的“比例不支持”提示，也让表单在 720p 档位提供了其实际线路只证实 16:9、9:16 的 3:4。

现在两项契约已分离：参考视频自身比例只是输入元数据，不再是准入门槛——非标准比例的素材仍可用于动作迁移，且该模式新增独立的成片画幅设置，仅提供当前线路已证实的选项。对象替换必须保留参考画幅，因此仅当参考视频自身比例是当前档位可产出的标准值时才可提交——480p 支持 16:9、9:16、3:4，720p 支持 16:9、9:16——否则在生成前以准确原因拒绝。工作台不会对特殊画幅静默裁切、拉伸或补边。

工作台同时新增 GET /pg/influencer/motion/options（仅限登录会话），让表单只展示当前线路已证实的成片画幅，且不暴露渠道或供应商细节。服务端真实媒体检查、时长边界、音频提取和原生计费保持不变。

title.en: Reference-video preparation checks
title.zh: 参考视频准备检查

summary.en: Character workbench uploads preserve special filenames, check actual reference media before generation billing, and explain preparation failures safely.
summary.zh: 角色工作台上传保留特殊文件名，在生成扣费前检查真实参考素材，并清楚提示准备失败原因。

body.en:
The checks are scoped to reference-video preparation in the character workbench, not all generic video API requests. The workbench checks the complete actual media for a duration of 4 to 30 seconds, without trimming an overlong video or audio tail or speeding it up. Submitted integer duration must match the rounded actual media duration; an explicit aspect ratio must match the displayed frame.

The intake ceiling remains 100 MiB (104857600 bytes), not a verified limit shared by every supplier option. Complete supplier input contracts remain unverified. Valid small files do not require compression; automatic compression is not enabled.

Generation uses a copy of the same validated video bytes without transcoding and keeps the complete embedded audio. A separate optional audio reference is attached only for a fully extractable reference of at most 15 seconds; longer references are not replaced with shortened audio. Original-sound reproduction is not guaranteed.

Media-preparation rejection precedes generation billing. Safe 400/408/503 preparation errors distinguish invalid media, mismatched submitted fields, cancellation or timeout, and temporary unavailability without reflecting signed URLs or raw diagnostics. This does not promise free failures after generation submission.

Uploads keep the original filename, including spaces or `#`, without requiring you to rename a valid file. Upload and preparation errors show the safe reason returned by the service rather than automatically suggesting a smaller file. If the actual duration exceeds 30 seconds, generation does not start and the message explains that the video will not be shortened automatically. File and media checks still apply.
body.zh:
这些检查仅针对角色工作台的参考视频准备，不代表所有通用视频接口请求。检查完整实际媒体，严格限定 4 至 30 秒；视频或尾部音轨超长不自动裁切或加速。填写的整数时长须与实际时长四舍五入后的值一致；明确画面比例须匹配实际呈现画面。

接收上限仍为 100 MiB（104857600 字节），不是各供应商选项共同验证的限制，完整供应商输入契约仍未核实。合法小文件不强制压缩，自动压缩尚未启用。

生成使用已验视频的相同字节副本，不重新编码，保留完整内置音轨。仅不超过 15 秒且能完整提取的参考素材附加可选的单独音频；较长素材不替换为剪短音频。不保证生成结果完整复现原声。

媒体准备拒绝在生成扣费前发生。安全的 400/408/503 准备错误区分非法媒体、填写字段不匹配、取消或超时及暂不可用，不回显签名链接或原始诊断。本条不承诺提交生成后所有失败都不收费。

上传保留原始文件名，包括空格或 `#`，合法文件无需先改名。上传或准备失败时，页面优先显示服务返回的安全原因，不会一律建议换更小的文件。实际时长超过 30 秒时，生成不会开始，提示会说明视频不会自动剪短。文件和媒体检查仍然适用。

title.en: Style-reference image for Create influencer
title.zh: 创建网红支持风格参考图

summary.en: Create influencer accepts one optional JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MiB as style inspiration, not an identity lock. Public generation request shapes are unchanged.
summary.zh: 创建网红支持一张不超过 5 MiB 的可选 JPEG、PNG 或 WebP 图片，用于风格借鉴，不锁定身份。公开生成接口的请求格式不变。

body.en:
Create influencer accepts one optional JPEG, PNG or WebP style-reference image, up to 5 MiB (5,242,880 bytes). This limit belongs to the website flow, not to public image-generation APIs.

The image guides silhouette, styling, colors, clothing and mood; it does not lock identity. A new character or a different person is allowed. Explicit description takes priority over selected traits; selected traits take priority over image inspiration. The selected exaggeration level still applies.

A reference image alone, without a description or traits, is valid. This path requests one full-body character on a plain white background without copying reference backgrounds, text or logos. Checks covering image-only input, an image with text and traits, and the same text and traits without an image all completed successfully. These results do not guarantee success on every request. Other modes, including multi-view output, are not promised.

The website uses the internal session path `/pg/influencer/sheet`, not a public gateway Bearer or `/v1` API. No public generation endpoint request shape changes.
body.zh:
创建网红支持一张可选的 JPEG、PNG 或 WebP 风格参考图，大小不超过 5 MiB（5,242,880 字节）。这是网站流程的限制，不是公开生图接口的限制。

图片用于借鉴轮廓、造型、配色、服装和整体气质，不锁定身份，允许生成新角色或不同人物。明确文字描述优先于所选特征，所选特征优先于图片参考，所选夸张程度仍然适用。

只提供参考图、不填写描述或选择特征，也可以提交。这一路径要求白底单人全身图，不照搬参考图的背景、文字或标志，仅图、图片加文字及特征、同样文字及特征但不带图片的三类核验均生成成功；这不代表每次请求都保证成功。不承诺多视图等其他模式效果。

网站使用内部登录会话路径 `/pg/influencer/sheet`，不是公开网关 Bearer 或 `/v1` 接口。公开生成接口的请求格式不变。

title.en: Google Nano Banana 2 & 2 Lite Models

summary.en: Google official Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image) and Nano Banana 2 Lite (gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image) are now available on OmniMux.

title.en: Scoped personal access token editing and MoeJS plugin engine
title.zh: 个人令牌权限动态调整与 MoeJS 任务插件引擎

summary.en: Released on October 5, 2026: edit token names and permission matrices with step-up verification, upgraded JS task plugin engine to Calcium-Ion/moejs v0.1.0-alpha.3 for zero-copy state and hardened execution, and added table refresh controls.
summary.zh: 2026 年 10 月 5 日上线：个人访问令牌支持改名与权限矩阵动态调整（需二次安全验证）；JS 任务插件引擎升级至 Calcium-Ion/moejs v0.1.0-alpha.3，禁止动态代码执行并优化零拷贝状态传递；渠道管理新增手动刷新控件。

body.en:
**Deployed on October 5, 2026.**

## Scoped personal access token editing

Personal access tokens (`nap_`) now support editing names and updating granted permissions via `PATCH /api/user/access_tokens/:id`. Renaming a token does not require verification. Updating the permission grant requires step-up security verification bound to the token ID and the exact new normalized permissions set, preventing proof replay attacks. The permission matrix in the dashboard UI provides categorized collapsible groups (Personal and Administration) with granular toggle buttons.

## MoeJS task plugin engine upgrade

The JavaScript task plugin execution engine has been migrated from Sobek to `github.com/Calcium-Ion/moejs v0.1.0-alpha.3`. The upgraded runtime eliminates reflection-based overhead, provides zero-copy host value transmission, passes raw JSON protocol states directly to handlers, and strictly prohibits dynamic `eval` and `Function` constructors to prevent arbitrary code execution.

## Console and gateway enhancements

- **Channels management**: Added a dedicated table refresh button alongside the 5-second automatic refresh mechanism, and resolved status tooltip text wrapping issues.
- **Task plugins**: Doubao Ark task plugin updated to support Seedream 5.0 Flash with per-model tiered pricing definitions.
- **Relay conversion**: Preserved custom tools in OpenAI Responses format when proxying to Chat Completions, Claude Messages, and Gemini Chat backends.
body.zh:
**已于 2026 年 10 月 5 日部署。**

## 个人访问令牌动态调整

个人访问令牌（`nap_`）现已支持名称修改与权限矩阵更新（`PATCH /api/user/access_tokens/:id`）。纯名称修改无需额外验证；调整令牌权限时，必须通过与该令牌 ID 及新权限集合严格绑定的二次安全验证，杜绝证明重放攻击。控制台安全设置中的权限矩阵提供按个人（Personal）与管理（Administration）分类的分组折叠面板，支持一键全部选择与语义切换按钮交互。

## MoeJS 任务插件引擎升级

JavaScript 任务插件执行引擎全面由 Sobek 迁移至 `github.com/Calcium-Ion/moejs v0.1.0-alpha.3`。新引擎消除了反射包装开销，实现主机数据的零拷贝高效传输与原生 JSON 状态直通，并在沙箱内严格禁止动态 `eval` 与 `Function` 构造函数，杜绝任意代码执行风险。

## 控制台与网关体验优化

- **渠道管理**：渠道列表顶部新增独立的手动表格刷新按钮，与 5 秒自动刷新机制互补；优化了自动禁用状态提示框的文字换行排版。
- **任务插件**：豆包 Ark 任务插件更新，支持 Seedream 5.0 Flash 图像生成与各模型分档阶梯定价。
- **协议转换**：完善 Responses 协议中自定义工具定义向 Chat Completions、Claude Messages 与 Gemini Chat 上游代理时的完整透传。

title.en: Scoped personal access tokens and device login
title.zh: 个人限定权限访问凭据与设备码登录

summary.en: Released on October 4, 2026: personal permissions, one-time secrets, explicit expiry, and device-specific browser approval. Legacy credentials retire on November 3, 2026 at 13:52:36 UTC; no new model or price announcement.
summary.zh: 2026 年 10 月 4 日上线：个人权限选择、明文仅一次、明确有效期与浏览器准确设备批准。旧凭据于 2026 年 11 月 3 日 13:52:36 UTC 停用；不宣告新模型或价格。

body.en:
**Deployed on October 4, 2026.**

## Personal access tokens

The release introduces named `nap_` personal tokens with selected permissions, independent revocation, and a secret returned only once. The browser creation form defaults to 30 days; never-expiring manual tokens require an explicit selection and warning. Token creation rejects an omitted or null expires_at rather than silently issuing a permanent credential. Token and browser-session management require a logged-in browser session. These credentials do not replace `sk-` keys for billed model requests. Existing `New-Api-User` headers may remain for compatibility but do not participate in authentication.

## Device login and migration

Device approval uses browser-only verification bound to the exact device, account/session, permissions, and expiry. Device tokens have a fixed 30-day expiry and personal business grants, without administrator/system or wallet-write permissions. A successful new login replaces only the device-token slot and the old single credential, preserving manual tokens. Existing CLI response fields remain unchanged. Legacy single access tokens have one shared retirement deadline, initialized once as 30 days later. The production deadline is **November 3, 2026 at 13:52:36 UTC** (`2026-11-03T13:52:36Z`); affected clients must sign in again rather than expect automatic conversion.

## Small compatibility fixes

The release preserves an explicitly disabled Responses WebSocket channel setting when saved and reopened. Unchanged saved pricing expressions/overrides can be retained under the supported usage-profile narrowing conditions. When removed fields prevent a safe visual conversion, the original expression is kept rather than guessing a replacement price. This is not a new price or a claim that all charges remain equivalent.

This release does not announce model launches, paid-generation acceptance, or later moejs work.
body.zh:
**已于 2026 年 10 月 4 日部署。**

## 个人访问凭据

本次发布引入可命名的 `nap_` 个人凭据，可选择权限、独立撤销，明文只返回一次。浏览器创建表单默认 30 天；手动凭据要永不过期须明确选择并看到风险提示。创建时漏填 expires_at 或传 null 会被拒绝，不会无声签发永久凭据。凭据管理和浏览器会话管理均需要已登录浏览器。这套凭据不能替代用于收费模型请求的 `sk-`。旧 `New-Api-User` 请求头可为兼容保留，但不参与鉴权。

## 设备登录与迁移

设备批准使用浏览器专用安全验证，绑定准确设备、账户及会话、权限和到期时间。设备凭据固定 30 天，只授予个人业务权限，不含管理员、系统或钱包写入权限。新登录成功只替换设备凭据槽及旧单凭据，保留手动凭据。原 CLI 响应字段保持不变。旧单访问凭据采用首次初始化起 30 天后的统一停用时间。生产环境截止为 **2026 年 11 月 3 日 13:52:36 UTC**（`2026-11-03T13:52:36Z`）；受影响客户端须重新登录，不能期待自动转换。

## 必要兼容小修

本次发布保存并重开渠道设置时保留明确关闭的 Responses WebSocket 值。符合用量范围缩窄条件时，可保留原样已保存定价表达式及覆盖价。已移除字段导致无法安全转为可视化编辑时，保留原式，不猜测替代价格。这不代表新价格，也不承诺所有场景扣费自然等价。

本次发布不宣告模型上新、真实收费生成验收或后续 moejs 工作。

title.en: Image routing and token reservation
title.zh: 图片选路与文本预扣调整

summary.en: Deployed request-scoped image groups and input-only token reservation; final prices are unchanged. Channel passthrough precautions are documented.
summary.zh: 已部署图片请求分组选路与仅按输入预估的文本预扣，最终价格不变，并补充渠道透传注意事项。

body.en:
## Release status

**Deployed on October 4, 2026.** This release updates gateway routing and reservation behavior; it does not launch additional models or claim successful paid generation.

## Integration changes

- Image requests use `model@group` or `X-Omnimux-Group` for an allowed request-scoped group; the header takes precedence. Matching enabled image plugins can handle requests, while unclaimed requests retain compatible image processing. Published model contracts determine response and polling support.
- Where token precharge applies, the reservation is estimated input cost multiplied by the configured reservation multiplier, default 1. Output limits are not included. This changes reservation size, not final unit prices or actual-usage settlement; fixed per-call and task-usage billing are not affected by this multiplier.
- Body passthrough bypasses normal rewriting and conversion. Header passthrough can expose client information and custom headers to the upstream; explicit channel header overrides take precedence.

New built-in plugin capabilities do not automatically publish models for sale. Availability and pricing require the live catalog and effective deployed configuration; actual generated output and reconciled charges require separate acceptance evidence.

## 接入变化

- 图片请求通过 `model@group` 或 `X-Omnimux-Group` 选择有权限的单请求分组，请求头优先。匹配的已启用图片插件可承接请求，未被承接的请求保留兼容图片处理；响应与轮询能力以已发布模型合同为准。
- 需要文本预扣时，按预计输入费用乘以配置倍率预留额度，倍率默认 1，不再加入输出长度上限。本项改变预留金额，不改变最终单价或实际用量结算；固定按次和任务用量计费不受该倍率影响。

新增内置插件能力不会自动把模型上架可售。可用性和价格须由实时目录及部署后实际生效配置确认，实际生成输出与扣费对账须另有验收证据。

title.en: Midjourney now uses two version IDs with per-request actions
title.zh: Midjourney 收敛为两个版本 ID，动作改为按请求选择

summary.en: Call model mj-v7 or mj-v8-1 and select the action with model_params.operation. The old per-action model IDs and the legacy `midjourney` ID are no longer accepted. Per-call prices are now tiered by action, and quality/speed/upscale-type multipliers apply on top.
summary.zh: 请改用模型 mj-v7 或 mj-v8-1，并通过 model_params.operation 选择动作。原有的按动作模型 ID 与旧的 `midjourney` ID 已不再接受。按次价格改为按动作分档，并在其上叠加画质/速度/放大类型乘子。

body.en:
## Required migration

- Replace the legacy `midjourney` ID and every per-action ID (for example `mj-v7-upscale`, `mj-v8-1-remove-bg`) with one of two version IDs: `mj-v7` or `mj-v8-1`.
- Select the action in the request body: `model_params.operation` = `generate` | `enhance` | `pan` | `outpaint` | `remove-bg` | `upscale` | `variation` | `edit` | `inpaint` | `remix` | `retexture` | `upload-paint`. Omit it for plain generation.
- Keep using `POST /v1/images/generations`; the request shape, the async task id and the polling behaviour are unchanged.

The old IDs are not compatibility aliases. An unknown or unpriced `operation` is rejected with **400**, never silently downgraded to plain generation.

## Pricing

Per-call prices are tiered by action, and the tiers are the same on both versions:

| Action tier | Price | Credits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `generate`, `enhance`, `pan`, `outpaint`, `remove-bg` | USD 0.113446 | 1.134 |
| `upscale`, `variation`, `edit`, `inpaint`, `remix`, `retexture`, `upload-paint` | USD 0.170169 | 1.702 |

Multipliers stack on the action tier: `quality: "hd"` (mj-v8-1) ×1.5, `model_params.speed: "turbo"` ×2, upscale `type: "creative"` ×4/3. `draft`/`fast` and `type: "standard"` stay ×1. Measured example: mj-v8-1 + hd + upscale + creative = USD 0.255251 per call.

The `mj-v7` per-call price moved from USD 0.056723 to USD 0.113446 to match what upstream bills for generation; the action tiers above are unchanged in absolute terms.

## Inpaint

Use the mask-image form: `model_params.mask.url` (an image URL or a `data:` URL, black = keep, white = regenerate). The polygon form `model_params.mask.areas[]` is rejected upstream with `invalid_parameters: Image dimensions out of range` in our measurements (2026-09-13), including with the upstream documentation's own example coordinates.
body.zh:
## 必须迁移

- 将旧的 `midjourney` ID 以及所有按动作的 ID（例如 `mj-v7-upscale`、`mj-v8-1-remove-bg`）替换为两个版本 ID 之一：`mj-v7` 或 `mj-v8-1`。
- 动作改在请求体中选择：`model_params.operation` 取 `generate` | `enhance` | `pan` | `outpaint` | `remove-bg` | `upscale` | `variation` | `edit` | `inpaint` | `remix` | `retexture` | `upload-paint`；不传即为普通生成。
- 继续使用 `POST /v1/images/generations`；请求形态、异步任务 id 与轮询方式均不变。

旧 ID 不是兼容别名。未知或无法定价的 `operation` 一律返回 **400**，绝不静默降级为普通生成。

## 价格

按次价格改为按动作分档，两个版本的档位一致：

| 动作档位 | 价格 | 积分 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `generate`、`enhance`、`pan`、`outpaint`、`remove-bg` | USD 0.113446 | 1.134 |
| `upscale`、`variation`、`edit`、`inpaint`、`remix`、`retexture`、`upload-paint` | USD 0.170169 | 1.702 |

在动作档位之上叠加乘子：`quality: "hd"`（仅 mj-v8-1）×1.5、`model_params.speed: "turbo"` ×2、upscale `type: "creative"` ×4/3；`draft`/`fast` 与 `type: "standard"` 为 ×1。实测例：mj-v8-1 + hd + upscale + creative = USD 0.255251/次。

`mj-v7` 的按次价由 USD 0.056723 调整为 USD 0.113446，与上游生成档实际扣费对齐；上述各动作档的绝对价不变。

## 局部重绘

请使用图片 mask：`model_params.mask.url`（图片 URL 或 `data:` URL，黑色=保留，白色=重绘）。多边形写法 `model_params.mask.areas[]` 在我们 2026-09-13 的实测中被上游以 `invalid_parameters: Image dimensions out of range` 拒绝，连上游文档自带的示例坐标也一样。

The model page at `omnimux.ai/pricing/<model-id>` now runs real generations. Its **Playground** section submits through the gateway using the signed-in browser session, so a user who has already logged in to OmniMux can try a model without creating an API token first.

- **From the console**: the page posts to the session-authenticated `POST /pg/video/generations`. This path accepts a browser session only and is not part of the token API surface.
- **From your own code**: keep using `POST /v1/video/generations` with an API token — the same contract documented in the video-series model pages. Nothing about the token path changed.

## Task results

Submitted tasks are read back through the same session: `GET /api/task/self` for status, progress and quota, and `GET /api/task/:task_id/artifacts` for the media projection. Tasks submitted from the console appear in the account's task list like any other task.

Console submissions use the standard precharge and settle path. No separate ledger, pricing rule or quota bucket is introduced for the console path.

body.en:
The gateway began requiring `provider` at **2026-09-07 07:25:20 UTC+8 (2026-09-06T23:25:20Z)** for listing accounts, starting a connection, disconnecting, creating a post and reading post status. Use `tiktok_direct` for official TikTok accounts or `zernio` for Zernio accounts. GET/DELETE carry it in the query; POST carries it in JSON. Missing or unknown values return `400 invalid-provider`; a resource from another source returns `409 account-provider-mismatch` or `409 post-provider-mismatch`. There is no default source.

### CLI migration

Use CLI **0.4.0**: `omnimux update` for binaries, or `npm install -g @omnimux/cli@0.4.0` for npm. Update all saved commands to include `--provider`, for example `omnimux social accounts --provider zernio`. For a read without upstream refresh, use `omnimux social post-status <post-id> --provider zernio --no-refresh`. Updating a binary does not update your scripts or prove all clients have upgraded.

CLI 0.4.0 also includes the previously merged hosted commands and video skill updates. Credentials use a mode-0600 file on every platform; Keychain-only installations need credentials configured securely. The Agent RPC envelope remains `contract_version: 1`.

CLI 0.4.0 was published on **2026-09-07 at 01:47:36 UTC (09:47:36 UTC+8)**. Both the public binary release and npm package are version 0.4.0.

Standalone binaries do not include skill files. Install the npm package to use or update the bundled skills; a binary-only update can report that the skill tree is missing even when the CLI upgrade succeeds.

### CLI 迁移

使用 CLI **0.4.0**：二进制安装执行 `omnimux update`，npm 安装执行 `npm install -g @omnimux/cli@0.4.0`。同步修改已有命令，补充 `--provider`，例如 `omnimux social accounts --provider zernio`。不刷新上游的状态读取示例：`omnimux social post-status <post-id> --provider zernio --no-refresh`。升级二进制不会修改脚本，也不代表全部客户端都已升级。

CLI 0.4.0 同时包含此前合入的 hosted 命令和视频技能更新。各平台凭据统一保存在权限为 0600 的文件中；仅使用 Keychain 的旧安装需要安全配置凭据。Agent RPC 仍为 `contract_version: 1`。

title.en: Account quota errors on OpenAI text endpoints
title.zh: OpenAI 文本接口统一账户额度错误

summary.en: Local account-quota failures return 402 insufficient_quota, preventing authentication misclassification and unnecessary retries.
summary.zh: 本地账户额度不足返回 402 insufficient_quota，避免误判为密钥失效或触发无效重试。

body.en:
OpenAI Completions, Chat Completions, Responses, and Responses Compact return HTTP **402** with `error.type` and `error.code` set to `insufficient_quota` when the local account balance or subscription allowance cannot cover pre-consume. Streaming requests receive the JSON error before SSE starts. Check balance or allowance before trying again; do not treat this as invalid credentials or temporary rate limiting. Token errors, upstream provider errors, other protocols, actual 401/403, ordinary 429, and 5xx behavior are unchanged.

Gateway enforcement began on September 7, 2026 at 07:25:20 UTC+8 (2026-09-06T23:25:20Z).
body.zh:
OpenAI Completions、Chat Completions、Responses 和 Responses Compact 在本地账户余额或订阅额度不足以完成预扣时，返回 HTTP **402**，`error.type` 与 `error.code` 均为 `insufficient_quota`。流式请求在 SSE 建立前返回 JSON 错误。应先检查余额或额度，再决定是否重新请求；不要将其当作密钥失效或临时限流。token 错误、上游渠道错误、其他协议，以及真正的 401/403、普通 429 和 5xx 行为保持不变。

网关于 2026 年 9 月 7 日 07:25:20 UTC+8（2026-09-06T23:25:20Z）上线该响应。
